packageRules.description: Python pins: tools/requirements.in compiles to tools/requirements.txt. Renovate edits the .in and re-runs pip-compile; it never hand-edits a compiled file (AGENTS.md).
Container base images live in Dockerfiles; a bump must be one focused PR so the engine-image matrix shows exactly which image changed.
Conservative automerge: low-risk Python patches and pins only, after the PR's checks are green. CI's auto-merge job is still the single landing authority, so this never opens a second merge path.
A container base image bump is never auto-merged: it changes what every image is built from and its build is the review.
GitHub Actions are pinned to full commit SHAs by scripts/pin_actions.py and updated by `make update-actions`, with the tag diff reviewed (docs/SECURITY.md). Renovate must not move them.
Major and minor Python bumps are never automerged: a minor numpy/gguf bump changes behaviour and needs a human read.
